import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
cases=[
 ('路径树不再校验标签互异','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','if len(labels)!=n-1 or set(labels)!=set(range(n-1)):return False','if len(labels)!=n-1:return False','test_mex_rejects_invalid_tree_labels_and_large_steiner_path'),
 ('分叉树接受任意排列','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','return any(alive[i] and degree[i]>=3 for i in range(n))','return True','test_mex_against_all_small_labelled_trees_and_all_label_permutations'),
 ('把任意树当路径','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','max(degree,default=0)<=2','max(degree,default=0)<=10000','test_mex_against_all_small_labelled_trees_and_all_label_permutations'),
 ('错误分叉阈值','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','alive[i] and degree[i]>=3','alive[i] and degree[i]>=4','test_mex_against_all_small_labelled_trees_and_all_label_permutations'),
 ('保留有环输入','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','if u==v:return False','if False:return False','test_mex_rejects_invalid_tree_labels_and_large_steiner_path'),
 ('连接词允许自身独立组成','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','return start>0','return True','test_words_against_all_segment_partitions_and_output_orders'),
 ('允许重复输出连接词','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','len(output)==len(expected) and set(output)==expected','set(output)==expected','test_words_against_all_segment_partitions_and_output_orders'),
 ('忽略遗漏的连接词','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','len(output)==len(expected) and set(output)==expected','set(output)<=expected','test_words_against_all_segment_partitions_and_output_orders'),
 ('允许输入重复单词','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py',' or len(set(words))!=len(words)','', 'test_words_reject_invalid_input_and_handle_self_repetition'),
 ('错误空结果拼写','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py',"output==['None']","output==['none']",'test_words_reject_invalid_input_and_handle_self_repetition'),
 ('连接词限制输出排序','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','len(output)==len(expected) and set(output)==expected','output==sorted(expected)','test_words_against_all_segment_partitions_and_output_orders'),
 ('去重打乱输入顺序','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','unique = list(dict.fromkeys(words))','unique = sorted(set(words))','test_repairs_preserve_forest_and_first_word_occurrence'),
 ('树修复后反转原边','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','return payload if n == 1 else repair_input(28187,payload)','return payload if n == 1 else repair_input(28187,payload).replace(b"2 3", b"3 2")','test_repairs_preserve_forest_and_first_word_occurrence'),
 ('不审核已有正确输入的答案','scripts/repair_gmyhf_review_findings.py','require(semantic.validate(number,repaired.decode(),output.decode()),','require(True,','test_prepare_uses_local_checker_preserves_alternative_stored_answers'),
 ('漏传局部语义判题器','scripts/repair_gmyhf_review_findings.py',"item['checker'] = str(checker.relative_to(judge.MIRROR))","item['other'] = str(checker.relative_to(judge.MIRROR))",'test_prepare_uses_local_checker_preserves_alternative_stored_answers'),
 ('重写已有可行排列','scripts/repair_gmyhf_review_findings.py','(31415, 31435, 30236, 29663)','(31415, 31435, 30236, 29663, 27952, 28341)','test_prepare_uses_local_checker_preserves_alternative_stored_answers'),
 ('错误命令行失败码','scripts/gmyhf_semantic_checkers.py','else 42)','else 1)','test_copied_cli_accepts_alternative_answers_and_rejects_wrong_bytes')]
results=[]
for name,path,old,new,test in cases:
 p=Path(path);original=p.read_text()
 try:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_semantic_checkers.SemanticCheckerTests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode})
 finally:p.write_text(original)
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch16-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':16,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
